issues.message: Task 3 design mandates _subdag.py (~100 lines) and _loop.py (~150 lines) extraction, plus _acquire_resource/_release_resource/_wait_for_resource_release move to resources.py. None of these were done. Only _helpers.py (11 module-level pure functions) was extracted. Runner.py remains 1388 lines (saved only ~76 lines).
208 lines — design.md specified ≤200 lines hard limit for _helpers.py. Exceeds by 8 lines.
References cli_help.py which was deleted. This doc file should be updated or archived.
References cli_help.py:COMMANDS. Should reference cli module HELP constants instead.

attempts.summary: No behavior-preserving optimizations. All modules have unique logic with no extractable duplication.
